name: Kholaseh SEO Analyzer
author: kholaseh Agency

sections.description:
Kholaseh SEO Analyzer is a powerful, lightweight, and frontend-only SEO tool designed exclusively by the Kholaseh Agency team.
This tool helps webmasters, content creators, and SEO specialists analyze trust signals, schema markups, and on-page SEO factors instantly.

Key Features:
* Instant scanning of page SEO status (Word count, H1, H2, H3 tags).
* Link analysis (Internal and External links counter).
* Image Alt text checker.
* Clean, dark-mode user interface for better readability.
* Fast, secure, and requires no heavy background processing (Client-side JS).
* Optional credit link — fully controlled from the Settings page.

Developed by Kholaseh Digital Marketing Agency. To learn more about our SEO services or get professional consultancy, visit our official website at https://kholase.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/kholaseh-seo-analyzer directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Log in as an Administrator or Editor.
  4. View any single post on the frontend of the site. Click the floating ‘آنالیزور سئو خلاصه’ button in the bottom right corner.
  5. Optionally, go to Settings → Kholaseh SEO Analyzer to enable the credit link.
sections.faq:
Does it slow down my website?

No, all calculations are done via client-side JavaScript only when you are logged in as an admin and viewing a single post.

Do I need an API key?

No, it is completely free and requires no external API connections.

Can I show a credit link to Kholaseh Agency?

Yes! Go to Settings → Kholaseh SEO Analyzer and enable the “Show Credit Link” option.
